summary: Iridium thin films were deposited using (MeCp)Ir(CHD) and molecular oxygen as precursors via thermal ALD between 225 and 350 /C14 C. The films showed good adhesion on Al2O3 nucleation layers, with surface roughness decreasing as temperature increased. The 50 nm thick film at 275 /C14 C had a roughness of 1.2 nm, contained about 3 at% oxygen, 0.6 at% carbon, and 1.6 at% hydrogen impurities, and had a resistivity of 9 mU cm.
